description: Official Pixazo media service providers extracted from PawFlow core.

cf_clearance.description: Cloudflare clearance cookie (cf_clearance value). Required when Pixazo's polling endpoint blocks your IP — extract from a browser session (F12 → Application → Cookies → gateway.pixazo.ai) and paste here. Bound to the User-Agent below + your IP, ~30 min TTL. Leave empty to skip — POSTs still work, only polling fails on flagged IPs.

cf_user_agent.description: Exact browser User-Agent the cf_clearance cookie was minted for (copy from the same browser request headers). Mandatory when cf_clearance is set.

model.description: Pixazo image model id (see pixazo_catalog.json, category=image).

poll_interval.description: Polling interval in seconds (for async models).

public_callback_base_url.description: Public HTTPS base URL that providers can POST callbacks to, e.g. https://webchat.example.org. Falls back to the agent runtime file_base_url when omitted.

use_webhook.description: Use Pixazo's X-Webhook-URL callback instead of polling for async models. Requires PawFlow to be reachable from the internet through public_callback_base_url or the agent file_base_url.
